subject: Error "wrong number of arguments in modifier (p3,q3) of element factor1=~BADS3"

messages.author: ca2bbf3d1fa56ead
messages.subject: Error "wrong number of arguments in modifier (p3,q3) of element factor1=~BADS3"
parts:
Hello There:

I am trying to run a multi group CFA (2 groups)and ran into the following error.\

Codes:

Actzero.model <- 'factor1 =~ NA*BADS3 + c(p3,p3)*BADS3 + 
c(p4,p4)*BADS4 + c(p5,p5)*BADS5 + c(p7,p7)*BADS7 +
 c(p11,p11)*BADS11 + c(p12,p12)*BADS12 + c(p23,p23)*BADS23
      

factor1 ~~ c(1, NA)*factor1

 
BADS3 ~~ c(p103,p103)*BADS3
BADS4 ~~ c(p104,p104)*BADS4
BADS5 ~~ c(p105,p105)*BADS5
BADS7 ~~ c(p107,p107)*BADS7
BADS11 ~~ c(p111,p111)*BADS11
BADS12 ~~ c(p112,p112)*BADS12
BADS23 ~~ c(p123,p123)*BADS23
BADS11 ~~ c(p312,q312)*BADS12 

BADS3 ~ c(p203,p203)*1
BADS4 ~ c(p204,p204)*1
BADS5 ~ c(p205,p205)*1
BADS7 ~ c(p207,p207)*1
BADS11 ~ c(p211,p211)*1
BADS12 ~ c(p212,p212)*1
BADS23 ~ c(p223,p223)*1


factor1 ~ c(0, NA)*1
'

ActzeroFit <- sem(Actzero.model,
                  data = BADS_merge, group = "Control")



summary(ActzeroFit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

Error:

Error in lavaanify(model = FLAT, meanstructure = lavoptions$meanstructure,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: wrong number of arguments in modifier (p3,p3) of element factor1=~BADS3
In addition: Warning message:
In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  :
  lavaan WARNING: small number of observations (nobs < nvar)
  nobs = 0 nvar = 7


I have double checked that the group variable "Control" was correctly labeled 1 and 0 for the two groups. 

Would appreciate any comments about what was wrong here. Thanks a ton!

Best

Yun Chen

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error "wrong number of arguments in modifier (p3,q3) of element factor1=~BADS3"
parts: Actzero.model <- 'factor1 =~ NA*BADS3 + c(p3,p3)*BADS3 +

Try removing NA*BADS3 from your syntax.  Instead, use the argument sem(..., std.lv = TRUE) to prevent the first loading from being fixed to 1.  The second group's factor variance will still be estimated because you have specified that in your syntax.

You could also try using the correct number of arguments to the first modifier:  c(NA, NA)*BADS3.  Despite the labels printed in the warning, I imagine the single NA vs. 2 "p3"s is causing the conflict.
